items.title: 2.9.1.5 Opening, Reading, and Closing Files (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of reading files (PDF 62).

blocks.text: File parhne ke liye usay open() function se kholein, us ke contents (andar likha data) parhein aur phir file close karein (band karein) ta ke computer ke resources (memory waghera) free ho jayein.

# Open and read a file
with open("example.txt", "r") as file:
    content = file.read ()
    print(content)

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"# Open and read a file": comment.
"with open("example.txt", "r") as file:": example.txt ko "r" (read, yani sirf parhne) mode mein kholta hai aur usay file naam deta hai. with block khatam hote hi file khud band (close) ho jati hai.
"content = file.read ()": poori file ka text ek string ki shakal mein content mein aa jata hai.
"print(content)": woh text screen par aata hai.
Yeh program tab hi chalta hai jab usi folder mein example.txt pehle se maujood ho; warna "FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'example.txt'" aata hai. Agle topic ka program (write/append) pehle chalaya ho to yeh "As-Salaam-Alaikum, World!" aur "Appending new line." print karta hai, aur aakhir mein ek khaali line.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein yeh code bikhra hua chhapa hai: line ke tukre do columns mein hain aur andar ki do lines margin par hain. Oopar tukre sahi order mein, aur with ke andar wali lines indented hain.

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: example.txt pehle se maujood honi chahiye, warna FileNotFoundError aata hai.

blocks.prompt: open("example.txt", "r") mein "r" ka kya matlab hai?
blocks.explanation: Read mode: file sirf parhne ke liye khulti hai aur pehle se maujood honi chahiye.

items: with open("file", "r") as f: content = f.read(); file khud band hoti hai.
